name: Bayesian Curl
movementPattern: Elbow flexion - shoulder extended cable stretch
grip: Underhand supinated grip on single D-handle, palm facing forward and upward.
description: Perform a standing cable biceps curl facing away from a low pulley with the shoulder extended behind the torso, maximizing tension on the biceps in the fully lengthened stretch position.
setup: Set an adjustable cable pulley to the lowest position and attach a single D-handle.
Grasp the handle with a supinated grip and take one to two paces forward, facing directly away from the cable stack.
Adopt a stable staggered stance with the working arm extended behind your torso into shoulder extension, feeling a deep stretch across the biceps.
instructions: Curl the handle forward and upward toward your shoulder by flexing your elbow.
Keep your upper arm relatively stationary behind or beside your ribcage to maintain stretch on the long head.
Contract your biceps forcefully at the top position with wrist supinated.
Slowly extend your elbow back under control, allowing the cable to pull your arm back into full shoulder extension and loaded biceps stretch.
Complete all repetitions before switching to the opposite arm.
cues: Feel the stretch behind you at the bottom.
commonMistakes: Swinging the shoulder forward during the curl, turning the exercise into a front raise.
Standing too close to the pulley, losing tension in the lengthened stretch.
Leaning the torso forward and backward with each rep.

logging.example: Weight pin set to 12.5 kg on low pulley: record 12.5 kg on that cable station.
logging.note: Unilateral cable movement facing away from stack; record selected pin load and note pulley position.

variantNote: Facing-away unilateral low-cable curl with shoulder in passive extension, creating peak passive and active stretch tension on the biceps brachii long head.
reviewNotes: FitTrack description notes: 'Cable biceps curl hvor du står et skridt foran kablet for at få stræk i biceps i bundpositionen.'
Prompt specifies standing facing away from low pulley with working arm trailing behind torso in loaded stretch in panel A, curled to shoulder in panel B.

sources.title: Menno Henselmans - The Bayesian Curl
sources.scope: Biomechanics of the facing-away cable curl, biceps long head stretch-mediated hypertrophy, and resistance curve alignment.
